rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland

WITH eu_territorial_units_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    geocode_regions,
    description,
    geocode_level,
    nuts_version
  FROM eu_territorial_units
)
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.country_id,
  i.geocode_regions_3,
  i.acronym,
  i.short_name,
  i.website,
  i.grid_id,
  i.db_pedia_url,
  i.wikidata_url,

  i.region_name
FROM institutions i

  ON i.geocode_regions_3 = e.geocode_regions
WHERE
  e.description = 'Nordjylland'
  OR i.region_name = 'Nordjylland'
ORDER BY i.unics_id

rows.question: Show the name of members in projects costing less than the average project cost.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_members_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
    COALESCE(pm.project, 0) AS project,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.member_name, ''), NULLIF(pm.member_short_name, ''), '') AS member_name
  FROM project_members pm
)
SELECT DISTINCT pm.member_name
FROM project_members_row_level pm
JOIN projects p ON pm.project = p.unics_id
WHERE pm.member_name IS NOT NULL
  AND pm.member_name <> ''
  AND p.total_cost < (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM projects)
ORDER BY pm.member_name

rows.question: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT p.unics_id
FROM projects p
JOIN (
  SELECT
    pm.project,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.unics_id) AS distinct_member_count
  FROM project_members pm
  WHERE pm.project IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pm.project
) pmc ON pmc.project = p.unics_id
WHERE pmc.distinct_member_count >= 100
ORDER BY p.unics_id

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH funding_schemes_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    fs.code AS code,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(fs.title), ''), fs.code) AS title
  FROM funding_schemes fs
),
projects_by_funding_scheme_agg AS (
  SELECT
    p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.unics_id) AS project_count
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.ec_fund_scheme
)
SELECT
  f.code,
  f.title,
  a.project_count
FROM funding_schemes_canonical f
JOIN projects_by_funding_scheme_agg a
  ON a.ec_fund_scheme = f.code
ORDER BY a.project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  (end_year - start_year) AS duration_years
FROM projects
WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
  AND end_year IS NOT NULL
  AND (end_year - start_year) = (
    SELECT MAX(end_year - start_year)
    FROM projects
    WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
      AND end_year IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY duration_years DESC, unics_id ASC
